content: Khri pung letah pung kheh cangnah
Mataico Abuipaw rai rawng tei thong a tlahpaw kama Paul tah Khazing tei a ca y hnohnangpaw he hringzia khatah a tlahpaw hringzia khei hring my lo tahpaw heh ka ca pasy he.
A pany la, ningnainá tah chih my lo; naa lung a sy sá la, doná tah pakheh le pakheh a cyhlang my lo.
Denah rui tei na khichai pawhe ceh thongtah Thlawpaw tei a pungkhehnah khah thlaw ly rua pawtah a zawng lo leimei my lo.
Y naa cangning tei hnabeisuinah sangkheh cawtah y naa cangpaw hrakhei pung pungkheh, Thlawpaw sangkheh,
Abui pakheh, zingnah sangkheh le, baptisma cangnah sangkheh suipaw a cang.
Khazing pakheh ung ka, Ama cawh kaa zongmingtei Paw, kaaning vytei kaa cung letah a ungpaw le kaaning vytei kaa chung letah rai a hrepaw cang ka, kaaning vytei kaa chung letah a ungpaw a cang.
Canghrasala kaaning pakheh cy khah Khri tah Ama a dunah naning tah ningdonah lahsong a ma peh cy.
Capathai letei a ciapaw cawh:

content.text: “Cung lang a kening takhei, sae a tlepaw sahlo he cawh a chuilai he ka, cawngsaw sahlo khah lahsong a peh he,”

content: a tah.
“Cunglang ke,” tah a silang cawh anai vypaw hminghmaw alui lang a za cung thah tahnah a cang.
Ma a za cungpaw khah alui le avai le a khunglang tai pahrang thlu ruapaw takhei vaicung a cung a sangnah caipaw lang a kepaw cawh a cang.

Thaikhehpaw sahlo khah apostol cangnah, thaikhehpaw sahlo khah Khazing khuavang cangnah, thaikhehpaw sahlo khah thawngchawbia reitu cangnah le thaikhehpaw sahlo khah pastor le cawngpahtu cangnah a peitu he khah Khri heh a cang hi.
Ma heh a rai a hre ruapaw tah Khazing cawngsaw sahlo pachiapaningnah khah a cang, ma pawsui co Khri pung cawh a changchy khy a.
Khazing Sawcapaw hnithainah le, angepainah kong letah pung kheh kaa cang thlunah tai le meh puitling cang tah Khri a tlingnah vytei kaa phahnah tai ma heh peizo a cang a.
Taico, tuileh tah a paleh a pathae laipaw nyheh hratah kaaning cawh cang khawh a bei he peh. Kaaning dungkhei pawtah aa zawngpaw he meh ziatai sahlo aa cawngpahnah khah kaa zingpaw cang a be.
Doná tah biahmuisui tukhah rei hri he peh ka, khrisawbu lu a cangpaw Khri leco zezongpui letah ka changchy he peh.
Ama leco pungpaluh cawh a pato thlu he ka, thahrui tah a peitlesah thlu he ka, pung letei a caibai takhei aaning le aa hre ruapaw rai cacy khah hre he ka, pung cawh donah letah a changchy.
Khainah sawtei hratah hringnah
Macawtaco ma heh ca ching he neh ka, Abuipaw ming tah bia ka ca patai he. Gental cawngsaw sahlo hratah ung khawh khe lo. Aaning sahlo aa rawhnah cawh a paly a palipaw a cang.
Aaning sahlo cawh aa lung mehco ka, Khazing hringnah taitah a chaichy he, zecawtamaw tatah aaning cawh aa lung a khongnah rawng tah hnithainah hnui bei he.
Ningzaw hnih khawh be ca he ka, aa ngaisawpaw dunah hohenah lekhei a pei he. Macawtaco a pathai lypaw maikaw lekhei a hmang he ka, tainah caang hnih khawh bei he.
Canghrasala, Khri kong naaning tei naa thuipaw cawh ma hraco a cang tlung be!
Zisu Khri letei a ungpaw biahmuisui hrakhei a kong cawh thui he ceh ka, Ama leco cawngpah naa cang kho.
Macawtaco, naa hringzia a paringpaw kong letah, dungkhei dunah tei a papia a paluipaw, naa cawngsaw cangnah paringpaw khah pahluhly la,
naa lungpuh ningcang khah a thapaw tah tua la;
dingnah le pathainah hmuisuipaw letah Khazing kha a lo pawtei tua naa cangnahpaw naa cawngsaw cangnah thapaw khah a hrei my lo.
Macawtaco dinglynah khah pahluhly la, pungkheh letei a peitlepaw kaa cang cy cawtah hei naa ingpaw cacy khah biahmuisui ching my lo.
“Na thing a ae tahmai tah suanah tua kheh.” Na thingaenah cawh ning tlahsah khui kheh la,
Setan khah a daw nápaw hminghmaw pei kheh.
Aa ru teipaw cawh ru khawh kheh seh la, a phahlahpaw sahlo pehlai khy hra pawtah ama a kih ceingei tah a chahnaipaw rai khah hre hri seh.
Biachaw ly khah naa kaw taitah papia khe la, ahianah hratah male a tua hry khypaw bia, nawthliatu cawtah a chahnaipaw tukhah papia hri my lo.
Taico Khazing Thlawpaw Pathai khah a nge chiasah khe lo. Tlangnah ning cawtah Ama khei cakhai naa cang kho.
Chiahrunah vytei, thingchia le thingae, male kha a hrychae lai, male thai pachianah le chahlynah a cangpaw maikaw khah vathlang thlu my lo.
Pakheh le pakheh zawngrawhnah hnui la, kong a pacang my lo. Khri thongtah Khazing tah a ca ngethai pawhe hratah pakheh le pakheh a ngethai my lo.
